en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Asbat, from a man from our companions, from the people of Khurasan from the children of Ibrahim Bin Sayyar, raising it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Allahazwj Knows that sin is better for the Momin than the self-conceit (self important), and had it not been for that, a Momin would never sin!’
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Ali ibn Asbat from a man of our people from Khurasan of the children of Ibrahim ibn Sayyar in a marfu’ manner from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Allah knew that sin is better for believing people than feeling self-important. Were it not as such, a believer would never sin.”
